sasha: Heads-up — I'm drafting a single-page mapping for internal error classes -> client-visible HTTP codes + retry guidance. Want to sync on a couple open questions before I land it. :thinking:
chris: nice. can you paste the proposed mapping?
sasha: sure, rough:
```
internal: ValidationError -> 400 (no-retry)
internal: AuthFailure -> 401 (no-retry)
internal: QuotaExceeded -> 429 (retry with backoff, use Retry-After)
internal: DependentServiceError -> 503 or 502? (retryable for short windows)
internal: ModelOOM -> 503 (no automatic retry; recommend smaller batch)
internal: RequestTooLarge -> 413 (no-retry)
internal: BadRequestSchema -> 422 (no-retry, include field hints)
```
chris: overall 👍. couple thoughts: 502 feels like gateway/proxy to me — if a downstream model host returned non-200 we probably want to translate to 503 unless it's an upstream protocol error.
devon: agreed re 502 vs 503. also we should standardize on always emitting Retry-After for retryable 5xx/429 when we know ETA. otherwise clients should fallback to exponential backoff.
maya: from product standpoint, we need the console to surface quota buckets + per-route 'remaining' so customers don't rely only on 429s. header examples: `X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Redwood-Quota-Limit`, `Retry-After`.
pm_alex: small nit: prefer `x-redwood-` lowercase canonical headers. and we should include an error_code field in JSON body like "redwood_error_code": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED" so SDKs can map reliably.
sasha: good call. I'll switch to lowercase headers and add redwood_error_code canonicalization. question: for ModelOOM do we want 503 or a 409-ish client guidance? model oom indicates request shape; maybe 422?
devon: ModelOOM usually means runtime couldn't allocate for requested batch+seq_len. that's actionable: recommend 422 with `redwood_error_code: MODEL_OOM` and include fields: `suggested_max_tokens` or `suggested_batch_size`. 422 aligns with schema/actionable vs infra flakiness.
chris: +1 for actionable errors returning 4xx when the client can change shape. reserve 5xx for transient infra and external service failures. keeps retry semantics clear.
maya: console UX: add a rule — for any error with redwood_error_code that maps to quota or usage, add a console alert and a link to 'explain' with quick fixes. ops_bot: note logged: created ticket INF-4823 to add quota headers to all proxy responses.
sasha: thanks team. last question: should we include a short `retryable` boolean in the JSON body to make SDKs simpler? example: "retryable": true
chris: yes but make it advisory. SDKs should still apply backoff and max attempts. include `retry_after_seconds` when available.
pm_alex: and document exact retry windows per tier in console docs (hosted vs dedicated) — different SLAs.
sasha: will update PR with these changes and add examples for SDKs and console. rough ETA end of day. :thumbsup:
